name: G1 ski, best benchmark

architecture.normalizer: obs_n = (obs - mean) / (std + 0.01), mean and std in weights.npz

files.weights: weights.npz: mean, std, eps, W0..W3 [out, in], b0..b3

observation.name: gravity
observation.desc: gravity direction in the body frame

observation.name: joint_vel
observation.desc: joint velocities, rad/s x 0.05, MuJoCo order

observation.name: ski_normal_force
observation.desc: snow normal force per ski, N / 200

observation.name: ski_v_along
observation.desc: velocity along each ski, m/s x 0.1

observation.name: ski_zones
observation.desc: pressure under front/rear of inner/outer edge per ski, / 175

observation.name: height_scan
observation.desc: terrain height minus pelvis height, clamped to [-3, 1] m, at body-frame x in [-1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.5, 5.0, 7.5, 10.0] m by y in [-1.5, 0.0, 1.5] m (x major)

observation.name: command
observation.desc: sin and cos of heading error, target speed m/s / 10

layout.name: lean
layout.desc: body lean target (roll, pitch) handed to SONIC as its command, rad after scale

layout.name: joint_residual
layout.desc: offsets added to SONIC's joint targets, rad after scale, SONIC (IsaacLab) joint order

action.downstream: joint_target = default_angle + (sonic(lean) + residual) * action_scale, then PD at 500 Hz

controller: NVIDIA GEAR-SONIC encoder/decoder, frozen (NVIDIA Open Model License); not included here
